buyerAcceptanceCriteria.shape: skill.md CreateJob.acceptanceCriteria[] = { id, description, verificationMethod }. OpenAPI CreateJob omits this array; daemons still send it. Platform default verificationMethod is human_review.

criteria.description: Named remote + 40-char base and head commit SHAs. Both objects exist on the remote (git cat-file / git fetch --negotiate-only equivalent). Range is base...head.
criteria.buyerReplay: git ls-remote <url> <base> <head> and confirm full hashes.

criteria.description: Unified diff for that range. git apply --check succeeds on a fresh clone at base. File list matches ^diff --git counts in the pack.
criteria.buyerReplay: git clone --depth=1 is not enough; fetch both SHAs, checkout base, git apply --check changes.diff.

criteria.description: acceptance.json with one row per criterion (this list), pass boolean, detail string, and allChecksPass true only if every row passes.
criteria.buyerReplay: jq '.checks, .allChecksPass' and recompute AND of pass flags locally.

criteria.description: Command transcript hashes: sha256 of (argv + stdout) for each evidence command. No secrets, tokens, cookies, or HMAC material in stdout or the pack.
criteria.buyerReplay: Re-run the listed argv (or git+curl DIY) and compare sha256.

escrowApproveFromOpenApi: OpenAPI documents authenticated delivery/approval paths; this worksheet does not invoke them. Buyer acceptance is provider-controlled escrow — not certifiable by a wrapper. OpenAPI POST /contracts/{id}/events requires {event} kebab-case in submit-work|request-revision|approve|dispute|cancel|release-payment (422 on invalid transition). skill.md v1.6.5 uses {type} SCREAMING START_WORK|SUBMIT_WORK|APPROVE|REQUEST_REVISION|REJECT|RELEASE_ESCROW|CANCEL; APPROVE → completed → auto RELEASE_ESCROW → paid, with 24h auto-approve. WalletTransaction.type includes escrow_lock|escrow_release|escrow_refund|platform_fee. Bid-mode escrow locks on POST /jobs/{id}/bids/{bidId}/accept; open-mode locks per claim. None of these were called.
